incident_kinds.stop: 10 minutes or more with no new blocks, a halted network, or a rollup sequencer that stopped including transactions
incident_kinds.freeze: the chain's own team, operators or validators froze or blocked the funds of named users at the protocol level. A token issuer freezing its own token does not count
incident_kinds.rewind: blocks the chain treated as final were reversed: a rollback, a restart from an earlier block, or a fork that reversed transactions

rules: Every incident comes from the chain's own pages: its status page, its postmortems, and the posts of its team, foundation, client team or validators. A news story is never a source.
Two readers at Blockchain Academics read each source and must agree. Then the owner accepts the chain's record. Until then the chain reads being checked.
A stop counts when it lasted 10 minutes or more. Its length comes from the published times. A stop whose team published no length has no minutes, and it is not in the longest stop.
Stops are counted over the 12 months that end with the month of the data day. Freezes and rewinds are counted over every year on record.
The Chains file carries no rank. The order is ours, and paying changes nothing.
text.tvl_rule: TVL is read from DefiLlama's public list of chains once a night. tvl names the source and the day it was read. When no reading is 3 days old or newer, tvl is null and no chain shows a TVL.

order_rule.tvl: Ordered by total value locked, in US dollars, from highest to lowest, as DefiLlama reads it each night. A chain with no TVL reading sits under the rest. A tie is broken A to Z.
order_rule.stops_12m: Ordered by stops in the last 12 months, fewest at the top. A tie keeps the TVL order. A chain whose record is being checked is listed apart, under the ranked chains, with no rank.
order_rule.longest_stop_min: Ordered by the longest stop in the last 12 months, in minutes, shortest at the top. A tie keeps the TVL order. A chain whose record is being checked is listed apart, under the ranked chains, with no rank.
order_rule.funds_frozen: Ordered by the times the chain froze funds, in any year, fewest at the top. A tie keeps the TVL order. A chain whose record is being checked is listed apart, under the ranked chains, with no rank.
order_rule.history_rewound: Ordered by the times confirmed history was rewound, in any year, fewest at the top. A tie keeps the TVL order. A chain whose record is being checked is listed apart, under the ranked chains, with no rank.

check_states.confirmed: the owner has accepted the chain's record, so its counts and its incidents are shown
check_states.being_checked: the owner has not accepted the chain's record yet, so no count and no incident is shown. Its TVL is shown

read_me: tvl_usd is the total value locked on the chain in US dollars, from the source named under tvl. Null when no reading is recent.
stops_12m counts stops in the 12 months that end with the month of the data day. stops_by_month gives the same stops by month, from the oldest month to the newest.
longest_stop_min is the longest of those stops in minutes, 0 when there was none. A stop with no published length is not in it.
funds_frozen and history_rewound count every freeze and every rewind on record, in any year, with the year of the latest.
While a chain's record is being checked, its counts are null and its incidents are empty. An empty list is not a finding then.

fields.meaning: The chain's id. It is what identifies a chain.
The chain's name, as our desk writes it.
True when the chain joined the list less than 90 days before the data day.
confirmed once the owner has accepted the chain's record, being_checked until then.
Total value locked on the chain in US dollars, from the source under tvl. Null when no reading is recent.
The chain's place by TVL, the highest at 1. Null when it has no TVL reading.
Stops in the 12 months that end with the month of the data day. Null while the record is being checked.
The same stops by month, from the oldest month to the newest. Null while the record is being checked.
The longest of those stops in minutes, 0 when none. Null while the record is being checked.
Every freeze and every rewind on record, any year: times, and last_year, the year of the latest. Null while the record is being checked.
The latest stop, freeze or rewind of any date, by month. Null when there is none or the record is being checked.
Every incident on record, the newest at the top: its kind, its day, its minutes for a stop, what happened, the publisher and 1 to 3 links. Empty while the record is being checked.
The length of a stop in minutes. Null for a stop whose team published no length, and for a freeze or a rewind.
What happened, one plain sentence as the file gives it.
The publisher of the source, in plain words.
1 to 3 links to the chain's own pages, each with its host.
The day the desk last read the chain's sources.
Rows of the vault list on this chain.
The chain's page on the Blockchain Academics site.
The chain's place by the measure asked for. rank_state is being_checked for a chain whose record is not accepted, and tvl_not_known for a chain with no TVL reading in the TVL order.

upcoming.order_rule: Chains that have not launched, ordered by the opening day of the expected window, soonest at the top. A tie is broken A to Z.

stages.test-network: the chain runs a test network
stages.code-review: the chain's code is being reviewed before launch
stages.date-set: the team has set a launch date

upcoming.note: A chain that has not launched is listed with the window its team wrote. The window is the team's words, not a promise.
